basis: Manual visual inspection of all four 1536x1024 raw boards, enlarged boundary-crossing cells, the despilled recomposed contact sheet, technical overlays and root-registered playbacks.

sameFullyHumanGauntBaldFeverishColonist.note: All poses remain recognizably the same bald, pale, gaunt adult human; no alien mutation appears.

identity.restrainedBloodAndBruises: present; no gore escalation or exposed chestburster
identity.limitedHarness: One circular abdomen/lower-chest node with straps and short tubing remains readable; minor generative placement/detail drift exists.
identity.anatomy: two human arms, two human legs, human skull/face; no claws, tail, inner jaw or carapace

direction.deathQualification: Prone terminal poses keep head/body progression to the right; face turns downward as part of collapse.

motion.idle: Eight distinct restrained feverish idle poses; loop closure is visually plausible.
motion.move: Eight distinct intentional unsteady human walking phases.

attack.openHandGrabShoveCore: frames 4-5 clearly read as reach/grab/two-hand shove
attack.defect: Frame 6 has a closed-hand full extension that reads partly as a punch, so a pure grab/shove-only claim is not supportable.

death.note: The authored one-shot ends prone; runtime hold behavior is outside this standalone processing pass.

observedDrift: shirt tear and restrained blood placement vary between generated poses
circular harness node radius/placement and short tubing detail vary slightly
facial bruising and shirt fold details are not pixel-identical across clips

algorithm.topology: union of a soft magenta-dominance tier within Chebyshev distance <= 8 px and a strong magenta-dominance tier within Chebyshev distance <= 48 px of exact opaque #FF00FF background; both tiers are foreground-only
algorithm.referenceSelection: nearest original foreground pixel that fails the soft magenta threshold, by expanding Chebyshev radius; within the first non-empty radius choose minimum squared Euclidean distance, then row-major y/x tie-break
algorithm.replacement: copy only the selected reference RGB onto the declared spill foreground pixel; never alter alpha/topology because the active sheet is opaque RGB
algorithm.fallback: if no source exists inside the local radius, choose the globally nearest original foreground pixel that fails the soft threshold using the same deterministic distance/y/x ordering
invariants: only pre-existing declared spill foreground pixels may change RGB
all exact #FF00FF background pixels must remain byte-identical
declared spill pixels after correction must equal zero

technicalCorrection.scope: RGB changes only on declared foreground edge-spill pixels

defects.impact: Strict grab/shove-only motion lock is not fully met.
Broad identity is consistent, but exact harness/tear/blood micro-continuity is not.
Current queue text still says claw or inner-jaw strike, contradicting the human reference lock. The queue is preserved unchanged; selected art remains fully human.
